name: NeRF MLP Architecture
definition: A multi-layer perceptron F_Theta that maps 5D coordinates (3D location x and viewing direction d) to volume density sigma and directional emitted color c.
summary: The NeRF MLP Architecture is a fully-connected network mapping 3D coordinates and viewing directions to density and color, distinguished by its use of Fourier feature positional encoding with ReLU activations.
